content.short: Bitcoin finance protocol behind LBTC, the most widely used yield-bearing Bitcoin.
content.description: Lombard points out that less than 1% of Bitcoin is used on-chain, and builds products to change that. LBTC earns Bitcoin-on-Bitcoin yield, now through an institutional strategy managed by Bitwise targeting about 2.5%, and is accepted by more than 50 protocols on 10+ chains. BTC.b moves Bitcoin onto six chains, and Bitcoin Smart Accounts and an SDK help apps integrate it. Over 270,000 users hold $3 billion of BTC through Lombard.
content.meta: Lombard's LBTC earns yield on Bitcoin and works across 50+ DeFi protocols, with $3B+ BTC onboarded by 270,000 users.
